Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to hear more about HelioHealth's throughput targets and the eval constraints around PHI-scoped workloads. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Recap: you're focused on reducing per-inference cost while keeping 99th-ile latency under 200ms for your realtime annotator.
- Next step: 30-minute product intro (short demo + Q&A) to align exec (CTO) + ops (Head of Data / Infra).

To make scheduling easier I pulled two compact timebands that keep the call within business hours for your team in EST and our team in PST: please pick one, or tell us a preferred alternate. All times below are shown with timezone conversions.

Option A — Wed, Dec 8
- 10:00–10:30 PST / 13:00–13:30 EST / 18:00–18:30 CET

Option B — Thu, Dec 9
- 08:30–09:00 PST / 11:30–12:00 EST / 16:30–17:00 CET

Agenda (30m):
1) 10m — product highlights + low-level path for latency/cost (Markus will demo)
2) 10m — how we map to your infra + routing/caching ideas (Ben)
3) 10m — Q&A / next steps / mutual action plan

Attachments: RI_30m_intro_deck.pdf (short deck), Helio-MAP.xlsx (skeleton mutual action plan).

Please confirm: (a) which option works, and (b) who from your side will attend (CTO? Head of Data? Procurement for licensing discussions?). If either option is tight, we can offer a third window on Fri morning PST.

Thanks — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm.
